While these intervals are designed to capture the majority of expected outcomes under typical conditions, certain high-impact events could certainly push the actual value beyond these boundaries. These "black swan" type events, while difficult to predict and quantify within standard probabilistic models, represent the primary risks that could invalidate the forecasted ranges.
